articles.title: Evernorth Health Services Teams Up with Direct Relief To Deliver Critical Medications to Communities Impacted by Disasters
articles.mainIdea: Evernorth Health Services Teams Up with Direct Relief To Deliver Critical Medications to Communities Impacted by Disasters
articles.summary: PR Newswire: Evernorth Health Services Teams Up with Direct Relief To Deliver Critical Medications to Communities Impacted by Disasters. Evernorth, the health services division of The Cigna Group (NYSE: CI), has partnered with Direct Relief to donate more than 41,000 lifesaving prescription medications for rapid deployment during natural disasters and other emergencies.
